module_summary: Direct-mapped 16-line write-through cache controller: a 5-state FSM latches the CPU request, checks tag/valid arrays for hit, refills from or writes through to memory, then responds.

anchors.name: n2_409
anchors.why: Idle/lookup/write-mem/refill/respond state; decodes all CPU and memory handshake outputs.

anchors.name: n26_cbf
anchors.why: CPU request valid; in idle latches address, write data and write flag, starts lookup.

anchors.name: n14_dbe
anchors.why: One-cycle CPU response valid decoded from respond state.

anchors.name: n8_706
anchors.why: CPU read data output from response register (hit data, refill data or write data).

anchors.name: n24_3c0
anchors.why: 16-entry data array, written on refill and on write hits.

anchors.name: n13_d16
anchors.why: Hit flag: valid bit and tag match; chooses respond vs refill and gates write-hit update.

anchors.name: n6_c12
anchors.why: Memory request valid asserted in refill and write-through states.

anchors.name: n20_98b
anchors.why: 16-entry tag array written with request tag on refill, compared for hit.

anchors.name: n15_9fe
anchors.why: Memory ack: completes refill/write-through, writes arrays, moves FSM to respond.

anchors.name: n9_f13
anchors.why: Latched request address supplying index, tag and memory address output.

anchors.name: n27_191
anchors.why: CPU write/read select, latched on request to choose write-through path.

anchors.name: n7_900
anchors.why: CPU ready, high while FSM idle and able to accept a request.

anchors.name: n12_4c5
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on refill, part of hit check.

anchors.name: n4_b56
anchors.why: Latched write data, sent to memory and written into data array on hit.

anchors.name: n10_3a8
anchors.why: Latched write flag steering lookup to write-memory state and blocking read-hit load.

anchors.name: n25_e09
anchors.why: Line index from latched address selecting tag, data and valid entries.

anchors.name: n1_a1c
anchors.why: Tag field of latched address, compared and stored in tag array.

anchors.name: n3_29e
anchors.why: Busy level while FSM in lookup, refill or write-memory states.

anchors.name: n23_d3a
anchors.why: Memory write enable asserted in write-through state.

anchors.name: n0_1cf
anchors.why: Memory read data written into data array and response register on refill.

anchors.name: n22_f8a
anchors.why: CPU request address latched into address holding register.

anchors.name: n19_bec
anchors.why: CPU write data latched into write data holding register.

groups.name: Cache FSM
groups.description: Sequences lookup, refill, write-through and response; decodes handshake outputs.

groups.name: Tag and data arrays
groups.description: Direct-mapped data, tag and valid storage indexed by latched address.

groups.name: Request latch
groups.description: Captures CPU address, write data and write flag on accepted request.

groups.name: Response path
groups.description: Response register loaded from hit data, refill data or write data.

groups.name: Memory port
groups.description: Refill and write-through requests to backing memory with ack.
